Its main activity is NACE 43.990 (Annen spesialisert bygge- og anleggsvirksomhet ikke nevnt annet sted); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2017 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 7.1 m and net income was -NOK 5.4 m. CEO: Ulf Anders Thomas Lidin.
